name: Conformance: Context-Budget Live Orchestrator (RFC 0111)
description: RFC 0111, the witness fixture (suite 2.41.0). A `core.orchestrator.supervisor` loop driven by the host's LIVE model — no `mockDecisions`, `mockDispatchPlan` or `mockPendingDecision` — because RFC 0111 §Scope forbids a mock supervisor from advertising `contextBudget`. The supervisor receives `config.instructions` as its objective and dispatches `conformance-noop` until it terminates, bounded by `settings.maxLoopbackIterations`. Each iteration's transcript grows; a host advertising `multiAgent.executionModel.contextBudget` reports what it fed the model through `GET /v1/host/sample/agent/transcript-window` (`host-sample-test-seams.md` §14), including `entries[] { eventId, rendered }`. For a full witness the run MUST put the budget under pressure (an older eligible event evicted or summarized); a host whose advertised budget this run never reaches records `partial-witness`. Hosts SHOULD run the live supervisor at temperature 0 with structured output so the decision shape is stable; the scenario asserts the host's accounting, never the model's words.

config.instructions: You are testing a transcript budget. Dispatch the worker conformance-noop once per turn. After it has completed six times, terminate with reason goal-reached. Do not ask the user anything.
